anti_goal_violations.evidence: ORIGIN (iter-7): during a heavy ingest on the grown live dev DB the backend exhausted its enforced memory_cap_mb=6144 ulimit -v ceiling (worker-thread MemoryError), GET /api/health hung 7+ minutes (all 22 threads futex_do_wait), the UI froze on 'Checking backend...' instead of the honest 'Backend unavailable', and recovery required a MANUAL restart. Human-acknowledged; iter-8 was the sanctioned recovery. RESOLVED ITER-9 on qualified evidence: four `except MemoryError` early-abort branches (data_manager.py:3049/3143/3186/3245) + post-bar-cache release (:3067-3068), 10 injected-MemoryError tests with a negative control; a 1092.93s full-universe rebuild + second heavy backfill in ONE process with 439/439 health polls HTTP 200 and peak VmPeak 4,738,948 KB (24.7% under cap), caps applied by iter-9's own shipped launcher block. ITER-11/ITER-12 CONFIRMATION that this specific dimension stays resolved: memory pressure recurred (see the iter-9 entry below) but /api/health stayed 200 throughout, the service self-recovered with later 200s, and NO manual restart was needed — the graceful-abort branches did exactly their job.
